title: CEditor Device Profile (DPD)
description: Native, open, versioned schema for a CEditor device profile. Implements Layer 0 (versioning), Layer 1 (identity / inheritance / scopes / override algebra) and the parameter/packing + provenance models from device-library-architecture.md. A profile is a manufacturer, model, variant, or reusable component. The resolved (inheritance- and scope-expanded) profile is what the panel/value-tree consumes via merge-on-drop.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of THIS schema. Bumped only on a breaking schema change (migration, not mutation).

version.description: Semantic version of this profile. Any change produces a new version; old versions stay resolvable (Layer 0).

kind.description: manufacturer = SysEx/checksum/byte-order conventions; model = parameter list + scopes + dumps; variant = deltas over a model; component = reusable fragment (mixin).

label.description: Human-facing name shown in the UI.

inherits.description: Parent profile id this one inherits (model inherits its manufacturer; variant inherits its model). Resolution order: own > included > inherited.

includes.description: Mixin component refs ('id@version'). Composed after inheritance, before own. UI-tier: ordinary authors never see these; they appear as resolved parameters.

manufacturerId.description: SysEx manufacturer id byte(s), space-hex. Manufacturer-level. e.g. '41' (Roland).

modelId.description: Model id bytes, space-hex. e.g. '00 00 41' (GAIA SH-01).

deviceId.description: Default device-id byte, space-hex. '7F' = broadcast (received by any unit ID).

identity.description: MIDI Universal Device Inquiry (Identity Reply) codes for Layer 4 matching. manufacturerId lives at the manufacturer level; family/member at the model level; firmware selects a variant. Absent => the profile can still be reached by manual pick or manufacturer-level degradation.

manufacturerId.description: Identity-Reply manufacturer id, space-hex (1 or 3 bytes).

family.description: Device family code (2 bytes LSB MSB), space-hex.

member.description: Device family member code (2 bytes LSB MSB), space-hex.

capturedReply.description: An Identity Reply captured from the real instrument, as space-hex — the evidence behind family/member. Never matched against; kept so a measured code can be told from an authored guess.

byteOrder.description: Default multi-byte value byte order for this maker/model.

messageShapes.description: Reusable wire-message templates (DT1, RQ1, etc.) referenced by parameter wires.

scopes.description: Named parameter spaces. A mono-timbral synth has one scope (not surfaced as a concept). A workstation has global + N parts, etc. Scope names use the device's own language in the UI (Part 1-16, Global, FX).

dumps.description: Bulk transfer definitions (patch/performance/bank). Reference scopes; tracked by verifiedFullDump separately from per-parameter round-trip.

overrides.description: Variant/model delta operations against the inherited+resolved parent. Applied in order. Removal is a tombstone.

completeness.description: How finished the profile is. Imported profiles that lack bit-level detail land as partial/structural-only.

then.description: A model must declare at least one scope (its parameter space).
A variant must inherit a model.

type.description: roland-7bit = (128 - (sum & 0x7F)) & 0x7F over [from..to]. sum-7bit = plain additive 7-bit. Distinct algorithms - do not confuse.

from.description: Start marker of the checksum range, e.g. '$address'.

to.description: End marker of the checksum range, e.g. '$encodedValue' or '$size'.

template.description: Ordered tokens: literal hex bytes or placeholders ($deviceId, $address, $encodedValue, $size, $checksum).

deviceStructure.description: Counts that drive scope instancing (e.g. number of tones/parts). Layer 4 may refine these from device inquiry.

kind.description: Role of this scope. 'global' = one instance. 'tone'/'part' = instantiated N times.

label.description: Device's own name for the scope (UI), e.g. 'Tone', 'Part'.

base.description: Base address of instance 0 (parameters address relative to this).

stride.description: Address increment between consecutive instances (added per instance index).

instances.description: Instance count. May be supplied by deviceStructure instead.

instancesFrom.description: deviceStructure field to read the instance count from, e.g. 'tones'.

id.description: Scope-unique id, e.g. 'filter.cutoff'. Resolved id is '<scopeInstance>.<id>'.

valueType.description: Drives the panel red/orange/green drag-fit check and the value codec. text = a fixed-length string living at ONE address (a patch name), carried by a text-ascii or text-nibbled-ascii encoding — not N one-byte parameters.

access.description: Whether the device can be read from / written to for this parameter (e.g. Master Volume may be write-only).

address.description: Default wire address, RELATIVE to the scope/instance base. Used for the DT1 write, RQ1 read, and (unless rxLive overrides) the DT1 the device emits on edit.

size.description: Number of wire data bytes for this parameter (default 1).

rxLive.description: Override for what the device TRANSMITS on a live edit, when it differs from the write wire. The GAIA case: cutoff is written via DT1 at 'address' but the panel knob transmits CC -> {dir:rxLive, msg:cc, cc:102, ccStride:1}.

wires.description: Explicit full wire list (advanced). If absent, wires are derived from address/size (write DT1 + read RQ1 + rxLive DT1) plus any rxLive override.

enum.description: Choice entries with their on-the-wire numeric value. Required for valueType enum.

wire.description: One directional wire binding for a parameter. dir=write (panel->synth), read (request value), rxLive (synth->panel on edit). msg picks the transport.

ccStride.description: Per-instance increment added to cc (GAIA: tone1 CC102, tone2 103, tone3 104 -> ccStride 1).

rpn.description: RPN MSB/LSB, space-hex, for msg=rpn. Selected with CC 101/100 rather than 99/98; the registered numbers the MIDI spec names (00 00 pitch bend range, 00 01 fine tune, 00 02 coarse tune) live here.

channelRelative.description: If true, the CC/NRPN/RPN channel follows the part/instance channel rather than a fixed one.

id.description: Stable choice id, e.g. 'pulse'. The bound control keys on this.

wire.description: The numeric value sent/received on the wire for this choice.

encoding.description: How a logical value maps to/from wire bytes. The same primitive expresses simple u7 through Korg 8->7 block packing; round-trip (encode then decode) must be identity across the full range.

type.description: u7=1 byte 0-127. u8=1 byte 0-255. s7=signed centered. u14=14-bit value over two 7-bit bytes, MSB first (Yamaha/Roland 2-byte fields); u14-lsb=LSB first. nibbles=value split across N nibble bytes (high nibble first). packed8to7=Korg block packing. bitslice=value assembled from declared bit-slices. text-ascii=`length` ASCII bytes, padded with `pad`; text-nibbled-ascii=the same, each character split across two nibble bytes.

length.description: Character count for the text codecs.

pad.description: Byte a text codec pads a short string with (default 32, a space).

packOrder.description: For packed8to7: bit order of the leading MSB byte. Korg 01/W,X3 = high-first; Electribe ES1 = low-first. INDISTINGUISHABLE by inspection - must be round-trip verified across boundary values (0,127,128,255).

groupSize.description: For packed8to7: internal bytes per packed group (Korg = 7).

slices.description: For bitslice: ordered list of bit ranges that assemble the value.

valueShift.description: Bit position in the assembled value where this slice lands.

presets.description: The device's preset model: what a slot IS (factory/ROM vs writable user, banks, categories), how to RECALL one, and how to READ ITS NAME. This is the structured counterpart to live scanning — the scan tells you what's in a slot now; this tells you what the slot is. Consumed by the Workbench Preset Librarian (blocks writes to ROM slots) and by preset-selector components. Formalizes the previously informal 'presetBrowser' runtime field.

banks.description: The device's slot partition. Slots are device-global integers; each bank covers [startSlot, startSlot+slotCount). Banks must not overlap.

nameRequest.description: How to read a slot's name (the formalized presetBrowser scan recipe): a messageShape/request id whose template takes the slot as a variable.

request.description: messageShape (DPD) / request (legacy engine) id sent once per slot.

slotVariable.description: Template variable that carries the slot number (default 'slot').

initPatch.description: The device's init/neutral patch, when it has one (the 'init patch' concept).

bank.description: Bank id containing the init patch.

label.description: Device's own name for the bank (UI), e.g. 'Preset A', 'User'.

role.description: factory = ROM (read-only unless writable overrides); user = rewritable slots.

writable.description: Whether the librarian may overwrite slots in this bank. Defaults to role == 'user'. Drives ROM-write blocking.

startSlot.description: First device-global slot of this bank.

programBase.description: Program Change number of the bank's FIRST slot (PC = programBase + slot - startSlot). Default 0.

bankMsb.description: CC0 Bank Select MSB selecting this bank (recall kind 'bankPc').

bankLsb.description: CC32 Bank Select LSB selecting this bank (recall kind 'bankPc').

category.description: Optional genre/category tag for the whole bank. A per-slot entry in `categories` beats it.

categories.description: Optional per-slot category tag; index = slot - startSlot, exactly like `names`. Length must not exceed slotCount. A blank entry falls back to the bank's own `category`. Verbatim from the device's own documentation — the AN1x prints two-letter codes (Ba, Pd, Sq) in its Voice List and gives no legend for them, so the codes are what is stored rather than an invented expansion.

names.description: Optional shipped factory-name catalog; index = slot - startSlot. Length must not exceed slotCount.

note.description: Free-text provenance for this bank — which page of which document the names or categories were transcribed from, and anything the document leaves undefined.

presetRecall.description: Parameterized 'recall slot S' action. The selector/librarian says 'recall slot 12'; this emits the right bytes per device.

kind.description: pc = Program Change only. bankPc = CC0 (+CC32) Bank Select then Program Change, using the bank's bankMsb/bankLsb. sysex = a template message.

channel.description: Fixed MIDI channel for pc/bankPc; defaults to the device/role channel.

template.description: For kind 'sysex': ordered tokens — literal hex bytes or placeholders ($deviceId, $slot, $program, $bankMsb, $bankLsb, $checksum).

provenance.description: Trust/quality record surfaced before a user relies on a profile (Layer 2).

verifiedRoundTrip.description: Every parameter packs/unpacks correctly (mechanical; hard prerequisite for library entry).

verifiedOnHardware.description: ISO date confirmed against a real device, or null.

importedFrom.description: Foreign format this was imported from (.ins, midi-ci), or null.

overrideOp.description: An id-keyed override operation (variant/model delta). Resolution: start from resolved parent, apply in order.

target.description: Dotted path to the inherited element, e.g. 'scopes.tone.parameters.filter.cutoff'.

value.description: Fields to merge (set) or the new element (add).

dumpLayoutEntry.description: One parameter's place in a dump's byte payload. Explicit - a device's dump byte order is NOT derivable from scope addresses.

param.description: Parameter reference: a resolved id (e.g. 'tone1.filter.cutoff') or scope-relative 'scopeId.paramId'.

size.description: Byte count; defaults to the codec's natural size.

codec.description: Per-dump codec; defaults to the parameter's own encoding. Superset of $defs.encoding: also u14 (two-byte MSB-first) and text (patch names).

pad.description: For text codecs: pad byte (default 32 = space).

spans.description: Scope ids this dump covers (a performance spans global + all parts).

requestShape.description: messageShape id used to request this dump.

message.description: Wire framing + payload + integrity of the dump. Universal across vendors.

prefix.description: Leading bytes that identify the dump (hex or $deviceId/$modelId).

offset.description: Byte index where parameter data begins (after the header).

pack.description: Optional block packing of the WHOLE payload before per-offset mapping (e.g. Korg packed8to7).

checksum.description: Dump integrity. Offsets are absolute in the framed message.

messages.description: SysEx messages forming a complete dump (banks).

layout.description: The device's real byte map - each parameter's offset within the payload.
